settings.text: We've been in the bagel business in New York for over 30 years and run 28 retail locations. Every bagel is hand-rolled and shipped from our Long Island commissary the day it's baked.
settings.image_alt: An assortment of bagels on a white background

settings.question: How do I get the 6 free mini bagels?
settings.answer: Build your dozen on this page and check out. A pack of Mini Bagels (6) is added to your box and the discount is applied at checkout automatically. One free pack per order, one per customer.

settings.question: Does it work with Subscribe and Save?
settings.answer: Yes. Your free minis ship with your first box. After that, each delivery is your dozen plus any add-ons you chose.

settings.question: Where do you ship, and how fast?
settings.answer: We ship from our commissary on Long Island, NY, and only ship Monday through Wednesday. If you place an order Wednesday through Sunday, it ships fresh the following Monday. We ship to the lower 48 states and Washington, DC — we can't ship to Alaska, Hawaii, US territories, APO/FPO addresses or outside the US.

settings.question: How should I store my bagels?
settings.answer: We don't use preservatives. Once your bagels are delivered, eat them within 24 hours and freeze what you don't eat. When you're ready, microwave for 30 seconds, toast and enjoy.
